proposedEdits.publicScope: Bibliographic metadata, original discussion questions and a reading locator only. No adapted report narrative, figures, formulas, benchmark statistics, case-study descriptions or claim of proven control effectiveness.

provision.title: Scalable oversight — reading reference
provision.summary: Read the original report for its research methods and limitations. Questions and concept links here are Atlas-authored.

roleQuestions.board: Would we make the same decision if the same verified facts were presented with a different emphasis?
roleQuestions.executive: Which parts of the reviewer’s evidence can be checked without relying on the AI-generated summary?
roleQuestions.regulator: How does the firm test whether accurate information is presented in a way that serves an undisclosed objective?
roleQuestions.assurance: Can we separate factual correctness from the effect that presentation has on a reviewer’s judgement?

readingRoleQuestions.board: Who decides which effects on customer understanding are acceptable for this AI service?
readingRoleQuestions.executive: Do repeated interactions change what customers believe beyond the purpose they authorised?
readingRoleQuestions.regulator: What evidence distinguishes an illustrative financial scenario from an effect measured in deployed services?
readingRoleQuestions.assurance: Does the evaluation result depend on access or training control that the real threat actor would not have?

proposedEdits.mappingBoundary: Proposed concept-mediated Atlas synthesis only. Referenced concept, control and risk IDs exist in the baseline. No source-authored crosswalk or risk likelihood/coverage inference. Controls are discussion pointers, not implementation or effectiveness mappings.

roleQuestions.board: Which layer of the AI service has no demonstrated security owner: its host, its AI components or its sector-specific workflow?
